golden_masters.visual_role: Close-range Muharraq and old Manama projecting timber window module

visual_acceptance.bahrain_identity: Projecting timber bay, shaded opening, limestone trim and restrained Gulf plaster palette must read as Bahraini traditional architecture.
visual_acceptance.primary_silhouette: The projecting bay and upper shade hood remain legible from street gameplay distance.
visual_acceptance.facade_depth: Opening, timber frame, hood, sill and wall plane use visible depth rather than coplanar decals.
visual_acceptance.material_control: Sand plaster, limestone and dark timber remain limited to shared mobile material slots.
visual_acceptance.adjacent_variation: Accent tone and timber slat spacing support repeated placement without identical visual rhythm.
visual_acceptance.scale_consistency: Nominal module width is 3.0 metres and opening proportions remain human-scale.
visual_acceptance.uv_integrity: Balanced profile shows no visible stretching on trim, hood or timber faces.
visual_acceptance.lod_integrity: LOD reductions preserve the projecting silhouette and never collapse the opening into a flat wall.

golden_masters.visual_role: Manama Souq gold-shop storefront with readable fascia, recessed display and shade awning

visual_acceptance.bahrain_identity: Narrow souq bay, bilingual-signage proportions, gold display tone and shaded arcade language must read as Manama Souq.
visual_acceptance.primary_silhouette: Fascia, awning and recessed display form a recognizable shop-front silhouette.
visual_acceptance.facade_depth: Display glazing, jambs, shutter pocket, fascia and awning use real depth.
visual_acceptance.material_control: Gold accent is controlled and does not dominate shared plaster, timber and metal materials.
visual_acceptance.adjacent_variation: Sign panel, awning depth and display segmentation support repeated storefront rows.
visual_acceptance.scale_consistency: Nominal storefront width is 4.0 metres with plausible door and display heights.
visual_acceptance.uv_integrity: Balanced profile fascia, awning and display surfaces show no obvious stretching.
visual_acceptance.lod_integrity: LOD1 and LOD2 preserve fascia and awning readability while removing secondary display detail.

golden_masters.visual_role: Bahrain Bay waterfront mid-rise tower used as a mobile-safe skyline anchor

visual_acceptance.bahrain_identity: Stepped contemporary Gulf massing, shaded crown and blue-glass rhythm must fit Bahrain Bay without copying a protected landmark.
visual_acceptance.primary_silhouette: Stepped tower tiers and crown remain recognizable at skyline distance.
visual_acceptance.facade_depth: Podium, tower tiers, vertical fins and crown are separated in depth.
visual_acceptance.material_control: Glass, limestone and painted-metal slots remain mobile-safe and visually balanced.
visual_acceptance.adjacent_variation: Tier offsets and fin rhythm avoid a single extruded-box appearance.
visual_acceptance.scale_consistency: Tower dimensions remain consistent with a stylized mid-rise skyline anchor.
visual_acceptance.uv_integrity: Balanced profile avoids stretched facade bands and inconsistent glass scale.
visual_acceptance.lod_integrity: LOD reduction preserves stepped massing and crown while removing fins and secondary bands first.

golden_masters.visual_role: Neighbourhood Bahrain supermarket storefront with canopy, glazing, entrance and service details

visual_acceptance.bahrain_identity: Deep sun canopy, compact storefront proportions, bilingual-signage zone and external service details must fit Bahrain neighbourhood retail.
visual_acceptance.primary_silhouette: Canopy, sign band and recessed entrance remain readable from the road.
visual_acceptance.facade_depth: Glazing, doorway, canopy, sign frame, kerb edge and utility zone use real depth.
visual_acceptance.material_control: Glass, painted metal, plaster and signage accents use shared mobile materials.
visual_acceptance.adjacent_variation: Sign accent and window segmentation allow repeated commercial strips without uniform repetition.
visual_acceptance.scale_consistency: Door, glazing and canopy dimensions remain plausible for a small supermarket.
visual_acceptance.uv_integrity: Balanced profile shows consistent texel density across canopy, plaster and signage surfaces.
visual_acceptance.lod_integrity: LOD reduction keeps the entrance, canopy and sign band while simplifying mullions and utility details.

golden_masters.visual_role: Original clean-room Bahrain skyline hero with twin sail-like masses and illuminated crown

visual_acceptance.bahrain_identity: Original sail-influenced Gulf skyline language and warm limestone podium must evoke Bahrain without reproducing an existing building.
visual_acceptance.primary_silhouette: Twin rising masses, central void and crown remain readable from long distance.
visual_acceptance.facade_depth: Podium, twin masses, central bridge and crown have distinct depth and overlap.
visual_acceptance.material_control: Blue glass, limestone and metal accents remain within shared mobile shader limits.
visual_acceptance.adjacent_variation: Asymmetric height and stepped crown avoid generic mirrored-box massing.
visual_acceptance.scale_consistency: Hero scale is internally consistent with the waterfront district and skyline background.
visual_acceptance.uv_integrity: Balanced profile facade bands maintain consistent scale over tall surfaces.
visual_acceptance.lod_integrity: LOD2 preserves the twin-mass silhouette and void while removing facade bands and bridge detail.
